title: DNA extraction from avian faeces
author: James Nicholls
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ve6e3he

steps.title: Prepare fecal sample
steps.instruction: Remove ~100‑200 mg of blue‑tit faeces (2‑3 fragments ≈5 mm each) from the storage tube, let any ethanol evaporate, and place the material into a 2 mL round‑bottom centrifuge tube (e.g., Eppendorf SafeLock). Avoid faeces with visible uric acid or scrape it off.

steps.title: Add Buffer ASL and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 1.4 mL Buffer ASL to the tube, add one 3 mm tungsten‑carbide bead, and shake on a Qiagen TissueLyser for 1 min at 24 Hz to homogenise the dried faeces.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K (stock supplied in the stool kit), vortex briefly to mix, then heat the suspension for 30 min at 70 °C.

steps.title: Vortex and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube for 30 seconds, then centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 1 minute to pellet faecal particles.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Pipet 1.2 mL of the supernatant into a new 2 mL centrifuge tube. Retrieve the tungsten‑carbide bead, store the remaining pellet for microscopy if desired, otherwise discard it.

steps.title: Add InhibitEX tablet
steps.instruction: Add 1 InhibitEX tablet to the supernatant, vortex continuously for 1 minute until the tablet is fully suspended, then incubate for 1 minute at room temperature to allow inhibitors to bind the matrix.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet inhibitors
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 13 000 rpm for 3 minutes, then discard the pellet containing bound inhibitors.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant and spin
steps.instruction: Pipet all of the supernatant (typically 400‑600 µL) into a new 1.5 mL centrifuge tube, discard the pellet, and centrifuge at full speed (≈13 000 rpm) for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K (second)
steps.instruction: Pipet 20 µL Proteinase K (kit stock or 10 mg/mL user‑supplied solution) into the 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Add supernatant to Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Pipet 400 µL of the supernatant from step 8 into the tube containing Proteinase K.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Buffer AL, vortex for 15 seconds to mix well (do not add Proteinase K directly to Buffer AL).

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 70 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ethanol (96‑100 %), vortex, then centrifuge briefly to remove any liquid from the tube lid.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column (first)
steps.instruction: Carefully apply 600 µL of the lysate to a QIAamp spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube, centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 1 minute, discard the collection tube containing the filtrate, and place the spin column into a new 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Load remaining lysate
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step with the remaining lysate from step 13.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 to the spin column, centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 1 minute, then discard the flow‑through tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 2 minutes, and discard the flow‑through tube.

steps.title: Dry spin column
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 1 minute, and discard the tube containing the flow‑through to ensure the silica membrane is completely dry.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column into a new 1.5 mL low‑bind tube (e.g., Eppendorf DNA LoBind), add 50 µL Buffer EB (10 mM Tris; not supplied in the kit), incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, then centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 1 minute to collect the eluate.
